newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA says bond auction covered 1.56 times.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA says bond auction covered 1.56 times.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Tuesday its auction of 100 million punts of the 8.25 percent bond due 2015 was covered 1.56 times.
The NTMA said the lowest accepted price was 114.26 to give an annual yield of 6.85 percent, while the highest accepted price was 114.47 for an annual yield of 6.83 percent.
The average price was 114.36, giving an annual yield of 6.84 percent.
The NTMA said a further 20 million punts of the bonds had been sold in a non-competitive auction following the competitive auction, at a price of 114.36.
